decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix builds on an established offer and costs little to keep on the website, but it lies outside the firm's announced industrial-technology direction, so it is the most likely of the four to be dropped.
The modular waste-to-energy extensions are a multi-model line that extends the firm's core plant business, which represents substantial invested engineering effort and core relevance.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a publicly presented flagship with its own page and heavy sunk engineering investment, so any weak early results would be attributed to a long sales cycle and the firm would persist.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is presented as a flagship central to the firm's sustainability direction, so public commitment and early-stage justification favor continuing despite uncertain results.
